mintAuthority.headline: Separate issuer minter and approver keys control issuance; one administrator can reassign roles and reactivate immediate upgrades.
mintAuthority.summary: At Monad block 113592456 (2026-10-15T10:44:07Z), the genesis-to-pin role census still identifies one ADMIN_ROLE EOA, one MINTER_ROLE EOA and one MINTER_APPROVER_ROLE EOA. No UPGRADER_ROLE grant is present, but the administrator can grant it immediately. The minter has 999,206.49 EURW remaining allowance; replaceable quotas are not an immutable whole-claim cap.

controls.evidence: At Monad block 113592456 (2026-10-15T10:44:07Z), the genesis-to-pin archive query returns four grants, no revocations, eight initial role-admin assignments to ADMIN_ROLE and only the initial implementation event. The grants are ADMIN_ROLE to this address, BURNER_ROLE to 0xf095cf0a76d6168e37e74c44b5ec11c607e14b5c, MINTER_ROLE to 0x259b74273f2a371f88cbc2cd8ca3339066600757 and MINTER_APPROVER_ROLE to 0x778b36adecb99a5a920106c441598879bfeb184c. Current hasRole reads confirm all four, and eth_getCode returns 0x for each. The administrator alone holds ADMIN_ROLE among these accounts; getRoleAdmin for all eight privileged roles returns ADMIN_ROLE. No UPGRADER_ROLE, BLACKLISTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE or RESCUER_ROLE grant appears in the full census. The administrator can activate these powers immediately; absent grants do not establish renunciation or a timelock.

review.evidence: The deployment receipt at block 61584206 (2026-03-15T12:32:16Z), transaction 0x3fb231fb1a9045f86604727f233e9ff8885cdc6dec1e9f4f0567fa3f03592f47, records the initial implementation and role configuration. The prior review found no proxy code at 61584205; that historical state could not be re-read from the public endpoint on 2026-10-15, so the refreshed launch binding relies on the receipt. At Monad block 113592456 (hash 0x177dfc84f382e3c2fc2c28d52114ff65e7d8e8a05aec8e4d730ce224cb81b6c4, 2026-10-15T10:44:07Z), EIP-1967 storage still names implementation 0x52778511bec5ff87f9b52c7a2434631edcc157f4. Symbol is EURW, decimals are six, totalSupply is 310193793600 raw units and paused is false. Genesis-to-pin archive logs contain four role grants, no revocations, eight initial role-admin assignments, only the initial implementation event and 591 Mint events, all naming the identified sole minter. Current role-admin and hasRole reads confirm separate administrator, minter and allowance approver accounts with no deployed code; the remaining mint allowance is 999,206.49 EURW. Administrator role grants can reactivate undelayed upgrades. The March 12 Hacken audit describes allowance-consuming minting, arbitrary replacement quotas and accepted allowance-overwrite frontrunning. MonadScan publishes exact-match verified implementation metadata; this does not claim repository-commit equivalence. Whitepaper D.1 describes issuance after settled euro deposits, a Newrails omnibus recipient wallet and internal-ledger entitlements. Its CloudHSM statement binds that omnibus wallet, not the three privileged authority accounts. The Bank of Lithuania register supports prudential supervision, not independent financial reserve assurance. The issuer product, whitepaper, redemption policy and public document archive, Bank of Lithuania register and exact issuer/token exploit searches were reviewed through 2026-10-15; no relevant exploited mint/control incident was located. Accepted audit findings are design risks, and this review neither proves absence of undisclosed compromise nor reconciles fiat reserves. Controller-specific signing and human-independence questions remain open.
